text: Walmart Q2 revenue rose 5.9% to $187.94 billion and global e-commerce grew 232%. U.S. comparable sales rose 2.6%. Walmart received about $2.8 billion of $2.9 billion in eligible tariff refunds, while global inventory increased 6.7%.

meta.note: Tariff refunds affect gross profit while health-and-wellness price caps weigh on U.S. comparable sales.

text: The 30-year Treasury yield rose over 6 basis points to 5.256% and the 10-year rose over 5 basis points to 4.704%, returning near levels preceding Wednesday's expanded-buyback announcement. The 2-year yield rose less than 1 basis point to 4.187%.

meta.note: The rebound follows the prior entry's yield decline and isolates the subsequent market-state reversal.

text: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said long-duration debt buybacks could exceed $4 billion per issue after Treasury raised the scheduled maximum from $2 billion to at least $4 billion. The final operation size remains conditional on market conditions.

meta.note: No upper limit beyond $4 billion was specified.
